name: command-13
description: An empty state that offers to create a new tag from whatever the user typed.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { Hash as HashIcon, Plus as PlusIcon, Tag as TagIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/command" export default function CreateFromEmptyState() { const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("") const [tags, setTags] = React.useState([ "brand-identity", "templates", "client-research", ]) const create = () => { const tag = query.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") if (!tag) return setTags((current) => [tag, ...current]) setQuery("") } return ( No tag called “{query}”. {tags.map((tag) => ( {tag} ))} ) }
